policy: BUILD-002 W6. A package whose Windows recipe runs nothing must be listed here with a category, a reason and evidence. The list can only shrink: converting a package makes its entry stale and the audit then demands its removal, and code/scripts/audit_build_windows.py ALLOWLIST_CAPS fixes the entry count per category, so a new entry fails until a cap is raised in the same reviewed diff. Do not add entries to make the audit pass; give the package a real recipe.

categories.intrinsic-apple: needs Apple frameworks (Metal, Objective-C); the package itself must say so
categories.intrinsic-platform: bound to a platform API with no equivalent on the others (reasoned, owner decision)
categories.no-tests-by-design: nothing to run: rule definitions, placeholder shell packages, notes-only BUILD
categories.tracked-follow-up: a real gap with a plan; these entries are the debt and must only shrink
